narrative.text: Valdek unrolls a topographic survey across your desk without asking permission. He has been trying to get this meeting for six weeks.

Dravenhollow. Sevagrad military zone. We have been buying Lytheirian coal and iron at a forty percent premium for thirty years because Halvek never authorized a proper survey. I have seen the preliminary strata reports. Chancellor, we are importing resources we are standing on top of.

Full survey costs ₭1.5 million. If Valdek is wrong, we borrowed against a hole in the ground. If he is right, the Republic stops being a debtor state within a decade. I cannot tell you which it is. Nobody can until we look.

Valdek has staked his reputation on this map. That means something — he does not stake it lightly. But ₭1.5 million on geological rumor while the treasury is already stressed is the kind of bet that ends careers. The limited option is the cautious choice. It is also, possibly, the choice that finds nothing because it looked in the wrong place.

choices.text: Limited survey. ₭500K. Sevagrad zone only — the strongest indicators.
No. Not now. The treasury cannot carry another speculative line.

narrative.text: Four weeks. My best teams. If it's there, we find it.

He rolled up his map and left before I could change my mind. ₭1.5 million committed before lunch. Vostane didn't argue. That either means she thinks he's right, or she's decided this is my wager to lose alone.
Sevagrad only. I'll need written clearance from Dusek's office to operate in the military zone. And if we miss something in Dravenhollow because we didn't look — I want that noted.

He wants it noted. I noted it. ₭500K and a targeted look at the most promising site. The conservative choice. Whether it's the right one depends entirely on what's under the Dravenhollow mountains, which we will not find out for some time.

Two syllables. He rolled up the map and left without another word. Vostane gathered her papers. Nobody argued because there is nothing to argue about — the decision is made. I may have just walked away from the most significant economic discovery in the Republic's history. Or I protected the treasury from a ₭1.5 million error. I will not know which for a long time.
